conditions.notes: OBS-0017 is the origin-side attribution OBS-0010's first reopening condition asked for, in the pattern of REL-0039 (OBS-0007 answering OBS-0006): the human channel attributes the transit transformations — all accidental — and in doing so reveals a hop the receiving-side diff could not see: the delivered text descends from the author's conversation-window rendering, not from the committed canonical file. This refines OBS-0010 rather than merely confirming it: the three-way undecidability (human theta vs epsilon vs intermediate tool) collapses to author-side double-versioning plus rendering loss, in unknown proportion, with the human as faithful carrier. The corroborating experiment (the source document delivered twice as files, byte-identical by sha256, the field's first verified-faithful delivery) supports OBS-0010's channel thesis from the opposite direction: the one channel that bypassed rendering preserved perfectly, so the transformation lives in the render-and-paste path, not in transport as such. Confirmation shape declared: human origin answering an AI observation, different observer classes, the only pairing whose agreement the dependence arithmetic does not discount.
